validation_scope: Generated repair; behavioral validation not run
summary: The flow reads attacker-influenceable text from a URLConnection, serializes/deserializes it, and writes it into an HTML response in CWE80_XSS__CWE182_Servlet_URLConnection_75b.badSink. The only neutralization was a weak `replaceAll("(<script>)", "")` that strips one literal substring and is trivially bypassed (case variants, broken-up tags, event handlers, other tags). I replaced it with full HTML-entity encoding of the metacharacters (&, <, >, ", ') so the value is rendered as inert text while still being displayed, preserving the feature for all valid inputs.
